source.name: Tanzil Quran metadata (classification and revelation order)

period.heading: Period of Revelation
period.text: The contents of this Surah testify that it was sent down after the hijrah at Madinah at the time when the fighting had been enjoined, though active fighting had not yet been undertaken. Detailed arguments in support of this view have been given in E.

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)

theme.heading: Theme and Subject Matter
theme.text: At the outset it is said that of the two groups confronting each other at this time, one has refused to accept the Truth and has become an obstruction for others on the way of Allah, while the other group has accepted the Truth which had been sent down by Allah to His servant, Muhammad (upon whom be Allah's peace and blessings).

source.name: Sayyid Abul A'la Mawdudi, Tafhim al-Qur'an (introduction to the surah)
